title: Instabooking Internship and Transition
content: Piyush built the entire backend of Instabooking during a six-month internship and received a PPO. After leaving, Instabooking pivoted to an education product, lost funding, and entered a difficult period. His role expanded to include content creation, sales, and teaching without prior agreement. Stipend payments were delayed repeatedly, with no formal escalation process. Piyush held firm boundaries, working official hours only and refusing weekend work. He completed Instabooking end-user training alone at an off-site location.
raw_text:
- Built the entire backend solo during a six-month internship and received a PPO. Has since left and is unemployed
- Instabooking pivoted to an education product, lost funding and entered a difficult period
- His role expanded without agreement into content creation, sales and teaching
- Stipend payments were delayed repeatedly since at least mid-June, with unanswered follow-up emails. A formal escalation path was discussed (Labour Commissioner, written record)
- Held firm boundaries: official hours only, no weekend work, didn't absorb company risk
- Completed Instabooking end-user training solo at an off-site location
